command:
set -euo pipefail
kubectl -n kcm-system create configmap qa-restore-probe --from-literal=proof=week1-live-backup-restore
kubectl -n kcm-system label configmap qa-restore-probe k0rdent.mirantis.com/component=kcm qa-restore-probe=true
cat <<'EOF' | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: k0rdent.mirantis.com/v1beta1
kind: ManagementBackup
metadata:
  name: post-upgrade-qa-restore
spec:
  storageLocation: aws-s3
EOF
